status: Unreviewed authored proposal; not measured values, native vendor equivalence, approved tokens or an implemented renderer.
layer_model: 01-taxonomy/layer-model.md; same canonical channels, with task 04 edge/scrim roles
amount_semantics: Ordinal cap on added style, never numeric opacity or semantic intensity. Apply role/context/nesting/channel constraints. None retains functional body/ink/marks/scrim. Trace display text requires explicit inscription context; ordinary UI text remains None.
resolution_order: resolve actual painted part and donor alias
take strictest role/context/nesting/accessibility/owner cap and channel prohibitions
merge channels by explicit owner, not duplicate layers
derive locally and select verified fallback

guards.title: Repeated text rows are a shared reading plane
guards.why: A row is an action/selection target but repeats inside one reading region. Painting each as an independent material slab would obscure scan rhythm and compete with the actual selected/highlight paint.
guards.rule: Row bodies: at most Trace, with no local blur, grain, cast, bevel or bloom; retain existing state fill. Row text/glyphs: None. Put at most Quiet material on the surrounding shell, with an opaque reading center. Selected/highlighted states do not grant extra decoration.
guards.amount_cap: Trace on row; Quiet on reading shell; None on ink
guards.basis: authored guard; sources prove existing parts/constraints, not this proposed intensity

guards.title: Code and syntax require a stable actual ground
guards.why: Syntax colors, diff lines, target rails, line numbers and code copy have distinct meanings; a role label of text/container alone cannot express these adjacent constraints.
guards.rule: Code/code-line bodies and ink: None for decorative transmission, gradients, texture, relief or glow. Frame/header: at most Trace. Preserve syntax colors, diff grounds and target rails. Collapsed fade is functional scrim, not a material highlight. Token/Code color swatches also use literal-color guard.
guards.amount_cap: None in code reading plane; Trace on frame/header
guards.basis: authored guard; sources prove existing parts/constraints, not this proposed intensity

guards.title: Authored conversation is not chrome
guards.why: Message content can be long and rich; user bubble, assistant content, action bar and streaming cursor have different jobs. Composer mixes a readable editing well with controls.
guards.rule: Message bubble at most Trace uniform tonal paint; assistant prose and composer input None for decorative effects. Actions may take Trace plate treatment; cursor retains semantic indicator and motion policy. Embedded code/media dispatch to their guards. No animated reflections or refraction under reading/typing.
guards.amount_cap: Trace on bubble/actions; None on reading/editing plane
guards.basis: authored guard; sources prove existing parts/constraints, not this proposed intensity

guards.title: Calendar selection is a connected field
guards.why: Days repeat on one grid; range bridges, endpoints, today ring and event markers overlap semantically. Independent glossy day tiles or edge shadows would imply unrelated raised buttons and break the interval silhouette.
guards.rule: Day plate at most Trace; no local blur/cast/grain/glow. Range bridge and markers keep exact shape and semantic fill, today/focus edges stay separate. Header controls may take Trace. Calendar surface may take Quiet; plain Calendar inside DatePicker has no second shell. Month/week geometry and hidden outside days remain unchanged.
guards.amount_cap: Trace days/header actions; Quiet standalone shell; no inner shell for plain
guards.basis: authored guard; sources prove existing parts/constraints, not this proposed intensity

guards.title: Travel, extent and selection cannot be optical decoration
guards.why: Thumb/track, two range endpoints, selected segment, alignment mark and progress bar encode coordinates or state; an attractive highlight can otherwise be mistaken for a second thumb or a filled interval.
guards.rule: Track at most Trace, semantic fill unchanged. Thumb may take Quiet (Full only a sparse, explicitly chosen large standalone handle after review); keep the core, focus and hit geometry exact. SliderRange has one rail and two logical thumbs, with overlap handling. Segmented selected item is a control, not a new moving lens. Alignment bars remain semantic glyphs, not bevels.
guards.amount_cap: Trace track; Quiet normal thumb; no extra decoration on encoded fill
guards.basis: authored guard; sources prove existing parts/constraints, not this proposed intensity

guards.title: Color is data, not material pigment
guards.why: Color samples, alpha checkers, hue/channel ramps and contrast checks display literal values. Recoloring or frosting them would falsify the interface, even if their role is indicator/fill.
guards.rule: Sample pixels, checker, ramp, contrast mask and value text take None. Material may apply only to surrounding shell/edge/handle outside the sample area. Preserve the native alpha checker distinction. A thumb that displays the chosen color keeps its core literal; material may affect its rim only. Picker shell Quiet, handles at most Quiet; no grain, tint, sheen or refraction across the actual color.
guards.amount_cap: None on data; Quiet surrounding shell/handle
guards.basis: authored guard; sources prove existing parts/constraints, not this proposed intensity

guards.title: Status and validation dominate decorative style
guards.why: Small marks, tone fills, validation text and loading/progress shapes carry meaning. A style-wide accent or glow cannot substitute for their core color, shape or temporal signal.
guards.rule: Semantic core and ink take None; enclosing body at most Trace. An explicitly emissive status may add Trace supplementary halo only when unclipped and not next to dense text; it never expands value extent. Forced colors keeps system marks. Loading/disabled/read-only remain distinct; material cannot add a false status animation.
guards.amount_cap: None semantic core/ink; Trace enclosing body or optional halo
guards.basis: authored guard; sources prove existing parts/constraints, not this proposed intensity

guards.title: A painted badge/keycap is not necessarily a button
guards.why: Passive tags, badges, counts, keycaps and avatars share visual shapes with action plates, while removal/overflow can introduce actual controls. Role-only material cannot decide interaction emphasis.
guards.rule: Passive body at most Trace, no raised affordance merely from a rounded shape. Removal/dismiss/overflow action owns its own Trace plate and glyph. Keycap remains a representation, not an interactive key. Preserve Tag tone and independent removal target.
guards.amount_cap: Trace bodies/actions; no invented interactive lift
guards.basis: authored guard; sources prove existing parts/constraints, not this proposed intensity

guards.title: Composition owns one physical boundary
guards.why: Joined controls and component aliases deliberately remove duplicate chrome or reuse another family on the same element; blindly applying both role recipes would double borders, shadows, blur or padding.
guards.rule: Resolve task 04 donor bindings before painting. One body/edge/cast owner per co-classed shell. Segments take at most Trace internal treatment; keep one seam with inherited geometry. Do not let an imported donor recipe re-enable stripped child chrome. Content parts retain their own role recipes.
guards.amount_cap: One shell; Trace segments, donor root aliases rather than extra paints
guards.basis: authored guard; sources prove existing parts/constraints, not this proposed intensity

guards.title: Media pixels are not recolorable glyph ink
guards.why: The closed task 04 vocabulary includes photos/video/flags under glyph or a media container. Their content is authored, and media readability scrims are functional.
guards.rule: Intrinsic image/video/flag pixels take None. A surrounding frame or container may take Trace/Quiet as its context permits. Preserve existing aspect/crop and local readability fade; never apply letterpress, neon, grain or material tint through an inherited glyph rule.
guards.amount_cap: None on pixels; no inherited glyph effect
guards.basis: authored guard; sources prove existing parts/constraints, not this proposed intensity

guards.title: Native painted subparts and browser fallbacks need adapters
guards.why: Native option popup, slider pseudos, file action, checkbox/radio mark and textarea resize grip do not expose the same paint hooks as a div. Generated pseudo content is already in use.
guards.rule: Apply the conceptual role to the actual painted native part, not a hidden input or wrapper. Enhanced native picker and classic OS picker are alternative paths. Keep opaque/solid native fallback; do not insert duplicate chevrons, marks or thumb geometry to force style parity. No browser-support claim is made by this matrix.
guards.amount_cap: Conservative existing native path when enhancement is unavailable
guards.basis: authored guard; sources prove existing parts/constraints, not this proposed intensity

guards.title: Functional edge/mark is not a decorative rim
guards.why: Focus, invalid, selected underline, target rail and insertion line can occupy the same pixel region as a material edge; some are drawn with box-shadow or borders.
guards.rule: Identify purpose before compositing. Required state paint wins and may suppress nearby decoration; it is never scaled by absorption. Do not recolor foreground on hover. Separate selected/highlighted semantics from cosmetic press relief and preserve simultaneous focus plus invalid/selection.
guards.amount_cap: Material contribution suppressed where it conflicts with required signal
guards.basis: authored guard; sources prove existing parts/constraints, not this proposed intensity

guards.title: Layout, hit targets and hidden labels are not receivers
guards.why: Groups, row slots, portals, modal wrappers, expanded hit areas and accessible text can be in the contract without painting a visible body.
guards.rule: Nonpaint and layout-only parts receive None until an actual painted child is resolved. Do not turn every container into a panel. Preserve target dimensions and hidden/live-region semantics. An overlay positioning wrapper does not gain its own floating material before its child.
guards.basis: authored guard; sources prove existing parts/constraints, not this proposed intensity

guards.title: Overlays need backdrop, arrow, clipping and scope context
guards.why: Modal and nonmodal surfaces differ, direct-dialog/wrapper backdrops are alternatives, and an arrow must continue the same shell. Popovers and tooltips can be rendered outside their trigger subtree.
guards.rule: One functional scrim per modal boundary, none invented for modeless Drawer/Popover. Arrow continues shell body/rim but has no separate blur/cast. Keep top-layer scope inputs explicit; derive locally after theme changes. Tooltip text remains plain and its small surface at most Trace; other reading overlays at most Quiet unless sparse context explicitly permits Full.
guards.amount_cap: Trace Tooltip; Quiet reading overlay; one scrim and shell
guards.basis: authored guard; sources prove existing parts/constraints, not this proposed intensity

guards.title: Large reading or inspector surfaces cap repeated effects
guards.why: A general container can be an empty visual showcase or a dense inspector/card/table frame; part role alone says nothing about sustained reading, repetition or interior controls.
guards.rule: Large reading body at most Trace and opaque, shell perimeter at most Quiet; avoid broad gloss/noise/colored variation under content. Panel sections share body and light rig. TableWrapper remains flush with its required frame rather than taking Card elevation. Shell clipping must not clip focus or nested popup.
guards.amount_cap: Trace reading body; Quiet shell boundary; TableWrapper has no new lift
guards.basis: authored guard; sources prove existing parts/constraints, not this proposed intensity

guards.title: Rules inherit structural hierarchy, not full edge styling
guards.why: Container seams, standalone separators, tab tracks and joined-control seams have different owners. Treating every divider as a full luminous/engraved rim would destroy the hierarchy.
guards.rule: At most Trace, one line owner. Internal seam must remain quieter than its containing boundary except the documented joined-control seam. Selected underline/target/insertion marks use semantic guard instead of being styled as separators. No external shadow on a rule.
guards.amount_cap: Trace structural rule; semantic markers exempt from decorative attenuation
guards.basis: authored guard; sources prove existing parts/constraints, not this proposed intensity
